'''Conference Room 2-Aurek''' was a meeting room located on the main level of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Var Suthra]] held a meeting there with the Republic scientist [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Orgus Din]] and [[Bela Kiwiiks]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]], and Din's [[Hero of Tython|former student]] to discuss the missing files for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" />

==Behind the scenes==
Conference Room 2-Aurek is a class-restricted story phase in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', accessible by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] players in the Coruscant mission
"The Jedi Envoy".<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> It was also mentioned as a Jedi Knight phase in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', released by [[Prima Games]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
